s1.texto: Samba, funk, techno and beach parties, sorted by date.

s2.texto: Three days before, a channel opens with everyone who's going. Ask, meet people and make plans.

s3.texto: Pick a meeting spot and show up with a crew, not alone.

s4.texto: Trusted rides with Rio Diferente, from your hotel to the party.

s5.titulo: Travelers from all over the world
s5.texto: Everyone shows their flag, languages and trips. When the event ends, the channel disappears.

metodo.texto: Choose how you want to sign in.
metodo.googleNoDisponible: Google sign-in will be available in the installable version of the app.
metodo.terminos: By continuing you agree to Bora's Terms of Use and Privacy Policy.
metodo.appleNoDisponible: Sign in with Apple works on iPhone. On the web and Android it will be enabled once the app is published with its domain.

olvide.texto: Enter your email and we'll send you a code.

nombre.texto: Others will see your first name and the initial of your last name.

foto.texto: A real photo of your face helps others trust you.
foto.ayuda: You'll be able to move and zoom it so your face is centered.

edad.texto: We never show your date of birth. Only the creator of a channel you join can see your age.
edad.menor: You must be 18 or older to use Bora.
edad.minimo: Bora is only for people 18 and over.

pais.texto: Your flag will appear next to your name in channels.

fotos.texto: Add up to 3 more photos. It makes breaking the ice easier.

estadia.texto: So others know if your dates overlap.

paises.texto: Mark the countries you've been to.

idiomas.texto: It helps you find people to talk to.

fin.texto: You can now mark which events you're going to and join the channels.

perfil.sinCuenta: You can browse events without an account. To say you're going and chat, create your account.
perfil.completarPie: To write in channels you need a photo, your age and your country.
